solution.what: HathiTrust record 100676638 (Puig 1920) tried in curl and the built-in browser: Cloudflare challenge, not solved. archive.org: no copy.
Google Books full-view copy of Puig 1920 found (id CuOlkxWnk-EC, Wisconsin). Book pages and PDF were CAPTCHA-walled, but the in-volume search endpoint and signed page-image URLs answered.

In-volume search for cifra/clave/descifr: p. 466 n. 2 says italics mark the deciphered phrases and Puig rebuilt the key 'a fuerza de paciencia' from lines Climent left on docs. 1063, 461, 463; preface p. 2: 'los diez u once escritos con desconocida clave' deciphered. Appendix index lists 14 'Carta cifrada' items, 1399-1416.
Appendix pages of every cipher item fetched and checked for gaps and for what Puig left unread (page-by-page check by a subagent).

Split under the one-key rule from benedict1399: this letter is from another sender and its key is not shown to be Benedict XIII's (the key was rebuilt on doc. 1068 only), so it gets its own entry with no claim about its key.

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): the one printed deciphered sentence copied from NOTES.md to texts/jafet1400_decryption.md, with Puig y Puig 1920 on Google Books linked; Puig's full printed passage not yet copied (project work); no transcription, since the cipher is neither imaged nor printed (needs physical access to the ACB original)

Looked for a transcription of the cipher: none in the folder; none in print (Puig y Puig prints the decipherment only; NOTES 23 Sept 2026); no image exists online (ACB not digitised). Recorded as transcription_missing. No new fetch was made on 14 Nov 2026: there is no source to fetch.

outcome.method_basis: The text is Puig y Puig's printed decipherment (Pedro de Luna, 1920, appendix XXXVII n. 2), found before the attempt; no image of the cipher exists, so nothing was checked against it.

texts.label: P. Jafet to Francesc Climent, 15 Sep 1400 (Puig y Puig's printed decipherment)
texts.summary: A cipher letter of P. Jafet, of Benedict XIII's circle, to Francesc Climent, Benedict XIII's chamberlain and agent, among Climent's Schism papers in the Arxiu Capitular de Barcelona. Puig y Puig deciphered and printed it in 1920; the one deciphered sentence he prints says that some of Climent's letters 'sunt intercepte hodie et recuperate'.

reading_review.note: Rests on Puig y Puig's printed decipherment (Pedro de Luna, 1920, p. 466 n. 2), of which the repository holds only one clause: some of Climent's letters 'sunt intercepte hodie et recuperate' (texts/jafet1400_decryption.md; English texts/jafet1400_en.md). The clause reads as sense, but it is a fragment of about 14 printed words and the rest is an external pointer (Google Books CuOlkxWnk-EC), not checked here: read in part.

texts.transcription_missing: The cipher was never seen: the letter (Arxiu Capitular de Barcelona, Çapera papers doc. 1043) is not digitised, Puig y Puig (1920) prints only his decipherment, not the cipher signs, and his one cipher facsimile (p. 475) is of another letter. No DECODE record. What would unblock it: an image of the original from the ACB (if the leaf is still there).
